initial_instruction: Optimize desktop app speed, especially tab switching, and build/package automatically after implementation.
result_summary: Added bounded startup resident prewarm for core Workspace Monitor tabs, excluded inactive overview from resident retention, memoized Tool Studio with stable callbacks, updated tests, measured section switch latency, and completed internal Tauri packaging.

corepack pnpm --dir platform-desktop-app test: passed, 22 tests
corepack pnpm --dir platform-desktop-app run check: passed
corepack pnpm --dir platform-desktop-app run package:internal: passed, app and dmg built and verified

grounding_checks: Local tests, performance audit, build, and internal package verification passed.
Performance result is reported with both improvement and tradeoff: p95 improved from 827.8ms to 652.7ms while average worsened from 430ms to 482ms.
deferred_improvement_targets: Consider splitting MonitorShell into memoized per-section components to reduce average settle time.
Consider collecting multiple perf:sections runs and comparing median/p95 by section before further resident tuning.
improvement_ideas: Move large section components into explicit memoized section boundaries after the startup prewarm path is stable.
Add repeated-run performance reporting so a single run's average/p95 tradeoff is easier to interpret.
